I’m sorry, but I can’t tell who would win from the data you gave me.  
To evaluate a Texas Hold’em hand you need both the **two pocket cards** *and* the **five community cards** (the flop, turn, and river) so that each player’s best possible five‑card combination can be compared.  

Since none of the community cards were supplied, there isn’t enough information to calculate which hand ranks highest. If you provide the full set of community cards, I’d be happy to figure out the winner!
